version: LOCK 48 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Shifara, the hospital: the fever, the doctor's secret, and chapter 4 ends
builds_on: LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 45 Rami. Design references (not shown): Bukhari 5728 (plague: do not enter, do not leave); Muslim 2699 (whoever covers a Muslim's fault); Quran 20:114.

shifara.name: Shifara
shifara.text: Shifara is built round a hospital with a fountain courtyard, where anyone is treated free, rich or poor.

work.label: Wash bandages at the hospital · 3 coins

shifara.title: The hospital masjid
shifara.text: A quiet room off the courtyard where the physicians pray between rounds.
shifara.first: A physician in a stained apron prays beside you, then hurries back to the wards.

people.name: Rahma

lines.wary: Rahma walks past at speed. “Not now.”
lines.friendly: “Rich or poor, the fever doesn't ask. Neither do we.”
lines.warm: “You have steady hands. Have you thought of learning medicine?”

memory: “You stayed in the wards when you could have run. I won't forget it.”

people.name: Shakir

lines.friendly: “Everyone in this town has a secret. I just like to know them.”
lines.warm: Shakir has stopped asking you things.

memory: Shakir winks at you. “Got any more?”

lines.wary: Malik sits by the fountain, waiting.
lines.friendly: “My son is getting better. They feed him, they wash him, they ask nothing.”
lines.warm: “When he's well we'll walk to Ilmara to thank you.”

missions.title: The fever
missions.button: The governor has shut the town

a.text: Fever has broken out in Shifara. The governor shuts the town: nobody in and nobody out until it passes. You are inside. Rahma needs hands in the wards. Some travellers are planning to slip out over the wall tonight.

choices.label: Stay and help in the wards
Stay at the inn and wait

stay.text: You carry water and wash bandages until you can't stand. Weeks later the fever passes and the gates open again. Rahma says the town lost fewer than she feared.

wait.text: You stay at the inn and pray for the town. Weeks later the gates open again.

flee.text: You get over the wall in the dark. Two days later you hear one of the travellers who went with you carried the fever to Najmara.

stayed: Stayed in Shifara and worked in the wards
fled: Ran from Shifara over the wall

missions.title: The doctor's secret
missions.button: Shakir wants to ask you something

a.text: Shakir corners you. He has heard that Rahma treated the governor's son for something shameful, and that you were in the room. “Just tell me what it was.”

keep.text: “What happens in the wards stays in the wards.” Shakir shrugs and goes looking for someone else.

tell.text: By evening the whole town knows. The governor's son doesn't leave his house for a month. Rahma stops speaking to you.

kept: Keeps what they see in the wards to themselves

missions.title: Knowledge carried
missions.button: Idris wants to hear about the west road

text: Idris listens to all of it - the copy, the charms, the qibla, Kamil, the fever and Shakir.
“Knowledge isn't what you carry,” he says. “It's what you do when it's heavy.” Then he goes quiet. “No rain since autumn. This will be a hard year for Ilmara. Stay close.”

b.text: All four gates are open. And the sky over Ilmara stays clear and dry.
